headline: Reviews,
before you buy
shots.sub: Every review marked where it reads as a person and where it reads as AI, before you spend a thing on it.
bullets: The mark sits on the words

headline: Somebody wrote
every star
shots.sub: Reviews read paragraph by paragraph, so the ones written by a regular are easy to tell from the ones written to rank.
bullets: A whole page at a time

headline: A store page,
read at a glance
shots.sub: The description, the highlights and the reviews under them, marked as you scroll, so a page selling you something is a minute's read.

headline: Notes and
replies, marked
shots.sub: The short posts and the comments under them are marked too, which is where writing gets written the fastest.
bullets: The feed and a single note

headline: Reviews for
the place you
are going to
shots.sub: A restaurant or a stadium, marked where the writing gives itself away, so the fourth-best review of forty is easy to find.

headline: Threads,
paragraph by
paragraph
shots.sub: Long discussions hold the most text on any page, and are where marking it saves the most reading.

headline: A whole essay,
line by line
shots.sub: The posts you subscribe to are the longest writing on the web, and Aeacus marks each paragraph as you read it.
